24:54.text: Say: "Obey Allâh and obey the Messenger, but if you turn away, he
is only responsible for the duty placed on him
and you for that placed on you. If you obey him, you shall be on the right guidance. The Messenger’s duty is only to convey
(i.e. to preach in a plain way)

24:55.text: Allâh has promised those among you who believe and do righteous good deeds, that He will certainly grant them succession to
in the land, as He granted it to those before them, and that He will grant them the authority to practise their religion which He has chosen for them
. And He will surely give them in exchange a safe security after their fear
worship Me and do not associate anything
with Me. But whoever disbelieves after this, they are the Fâsiqûn

24:56.text: , and give Zakât and obey the Messenger

24:57.text: Consider not that the disbelievers can escape in the land. Their abode shall be the Fire - and worst indeed is that destination.

24:58.text: O you who believe! Let your slaves and slave-girls, and those among you who have not come to the age of puberty ask your permission
, and while you put off your clothes for the noonday
three times are of privacy for you; other than these times there is no sin on you or on them to move about, attending to each other. Thus Allâh makes clear the Ayât
(the Verses of this Qur’ân, showing proofs for the legal aspects of permission for visits)
to you. And Allâh is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
